title: ROW returns one row with a column per name and expression pair

source.quote: Returns a table with a single row containing values that result from the expressions given to each column.
source.supports: one row, one column per pair

source.quote: -- ROW generates a table with one row only. -- You provide the name of the columns and their values.

derivation: Three pairs give three columns named [a], [b], [c], holding an integer, a string and a decimal number.
